title: Legal research
intro: Ask a general legal question. The answer is searched in official legal sources first, then on the web, and every source is shown.
noCaseData: Do not include names or details from a case: only the question is sent, after personal data is hidden, to an external research service.

form.question: Your question
form.questionPlaceholder: For example: what is the notice period for ending an employment contract?
form.jurisdictionHint: Your office's jurisdiction is used unless you pick another one.

failed: The research could not be completed

answer.title: Answer
answer.unsourcedHint: No source was found for this answer. Check it against the law before relying on it.
